# The Local Cabinetry
> Custom and ready-to-assemble cabinetry - kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, closets and wardrobes. Flat-door cabinets built to your size, plus our standard RTA range. Shipped flat from 6 warehouses nationwide. Free 3D design and quote. Certified TSCA Title VI, KCMA, CARB2, NGBS Green.

Previously known as The Local Cabinets (thelocalcabinets.com); same company, same team.

## Custom and RTA: we do both
- [Custom Cabinets](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/custom-cabinets/): The Local Cabinetry sells ready-to-assemble (RTA) cabinets from a standard range and builds custom work to the customer's measurements, for delivery anywhere in the United States.
- Made to size: cabinets with flat (slab) doors are built to the width, height and depth the customer needs (kitchens, vanities, closets, built-ins). A front wider than 48" is split into two doors.
- Shaker, slim shaker and raised-panel doors come in set sizes: those runs are planned from standard cabinets with filler strips cut to the wall.
- Taller counters with any door style: standard base cabinets on a raised platform with levelers (for example a 37-39" counter).
- Also built: tall pantry, desk and bench cabinets, islands planned from base cabinets, closet towers with hanging rods, glass-front doors, panel-ready dishwasher fronts in the door finish, matching crown molding.
- Finishes: chosen from the catalog (painted, woodgrain, matte and high-gloss; for example Shaker White, Navy Blue, Sage Breeze, Slim White Oak, Oak Blonde, Matte Black, High Glossy White).
- Every cabinet, standard or custom, ships flat-packed (RTA). Local installation in the Houston area.
- How to start: a layout in the design tool (https://thelocalcabinetry.com/design) or wall measurements and photos through https://thelocalcabinetry.com/contact; free 3D design and itemized quote. Lead time is about 7 days; shipping within the US then takes 3 to 7 days; for custom work the production time is confirmed when the order is placed.
- Showroom: Houston, Texas, by appointment (book through the contact page). Countertops are by others.

## Product Lines
- [Kitchen Cabinets](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/c/kitchen-cabinets/): Shaker, Slim Shaker, and handleless kitchen cabinetry. RTA (ready-to-assemble), customizable layouts. Starting from $99.99 per linear foot.
- [Bathroom Vanities](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/c/bathroom-vanities/): Single and double vanities with soft-close drawers and moisture-tolerant finishes, sized to your bathroom. From $119.99 per linear foot.
- [Closets & Wardrobes](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/c/closets-wardrobes/): Walk-in and reach-in closets with shelving, drawers and rails. From $149.99 per linear foot.
- [Cabinet Door Styles & Finishes](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/door-styles/): Six door collections (Shaker, Slim Shaker, Double Shaker, Iris, Vienna, Cottage) in painted and stained finishes. Free door samples available.
- [Interior Doors](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/interior-doors/): PET room doors made to match cabinet finishes.
- [Accessories](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/accessories/): Drawer boxes, drawer slides, handles, hinges, LED lighting, organizers, trim panels - sold separately, stocked in U.S. warehouses.

## Guides & Buying Help
- [Cabinet Cost Guide](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/cost-guide/): How per-linear-foot pricing works, with worked examples - kitchens ~$2,500 for a 10×10, vanities from ~$600, closets from ~$1,200. Cabinets only; quoted free.
- [How to Measure Your Kitchen](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/how-to-measure-your-kitchen/): 6-step guide to measuring a kitchen for cabinets; standard sizes (base 34½″H×24″D, wall 12″D at 30/36/42″H).
- [How to Measure Your Bathroom](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/how-to-measure-your-bathroom/): Measuring for a vanity - wall width, usable depth, plumbing position, single vs double (double from ~60″).
- [How to Measure Your Closet](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/how-to-measure-your-closet/): Measuring a closet for a system - wall lengths, ceiling height, hanging clearances (~42″ double-hang, ~70″ long-hang).
- [Houston, TX](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/houston/): Houston-based; serves Houston and surrounding areas (Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress, Spring) plus nationwide shipping.
- [Membership](https://thelocalcabinetry.com/member/): 10% off all orders, free 3D layouts and quotes, priority lead times and a dedicated rep. $20 per month, billed yearly ($240 per year). The standard price list is the same for everyone.

## Key Facts
- Construction, kitchen and bath (shaker lines): 1/2" cabinet-grade plywood box, UV-coated interior, no particleboard. Full-overlay doors. Dovetailed solid-wood drawer boxes. Soft-close hinges and undermount glides throughout.
- Construction, frameless kitchen line: 3/4" plywood box and drawer boxes in white melamine, no face frame.
- Construction, closets: 3/4" particleboard towers, finished on both sides, every visible edge banded; flat fronts.
- Certifications: TSCA Title VI, KCMA, CARB2, NGBS Green.
- Fulfillment: 6 U.S. warehouses - Houston TX (base), Phoenix AZ, Chicago IL, Ohio, North Carolina, Florida. Ships flat (RTA).
- Design service: free 3D design and non-binding quote. Free door samples.
- Pricing model: quoted per project; "from" prices are per linear foot of cabinetry. A typical 10x10 kitchen is about 25 linear feet, so kitchens start around $2,500 in cabinets.
- Contact: info@thelocalcabinetry.com · or the contact form at https://thelocalcabinetry.com/contact/

## Planning Reference (standard sizes)
- Base cabinets: 34 1/2" high, 24" deep. Wall cabinets: 12" deep, 30/36/42" high.
- Countertop: 1 1/2" thick, 25 1/2" deep. Counter-to-wall-cabinet clearance: 18".
- Appliance allowances: refrigerator 36"w x 72"h, dishwasher 24"w, range 30"w.

## About
The Local Cabinetry (Luxlive Home LLC) is a Houston, Texas-based cabinetry brand backed by 18+ years of custom-cabinetry manufacturing expertise. Serving homeowners, builders, contractors and developers nationwide. Membership: https://thelocalcabinetry.com/member/
